Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Moderate Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Complex tear of the anterior root, anterior horn, body, and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus with a dominant horizontal component and a para meniscal cyst abutting the meniscal body. There is mild meniscal extrusion.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Focal full-thickness cartilage fissuring along the posterior weightbearing lateral femoral condyle.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Broad areas of full-thickness cartilage loss spanning the median ridge and lateral patellar facet with subchondral cystic change. Full-thickness cartilage loss at the periphery of the lateral trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps tendinosis.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Mild soft tissue edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. There is patella alta Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Complex tearing of the lateral meniscus with dominant horizontal component, associated parameniscal cyst, and mild lateral compartment chondrosis.

2. Findings suggestive of lateral patellofemoral maltracking with grade 4 patellofemoral compartment chondrosis, mild Hoffa's fat pad impingement, mild distal quadriceps tendinosis, and patella alta configuration.

3. Small joint effusion and moderate Baker's cyst.

Gonalgia bilateral.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea, salvo pequeña lesión focal,
probablemente condroide de 5 mm de la región metafisaria distal del fémur.

Medyal menisküs arka boynuzu-gövdesindeki dejenerasyona yırtık eşlik etmiyor. Lateral menisküs gövdesi düzeyinde serbest kenar düzensizliği bu düzeydeki püsküllenme tarzında yırtık açısından şüpheli. İç yan bağın femoral insersiyona yakın kesimdeki intraoseöz gangliyon kisti 1 cm çapında. Patellofemoral eklem dejenerasyonu patella apeksi ve çevresindeki troklear kıkırdağın santralindeki kondral kalınlığın %50'sine ulaşan incelme ve milimetrik çaplı subkondral fibrovasküler değişiklikler ile karakterize. Posterolateral ve posteromedyal köşe yapıları korunmuş. Eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler bunların dışında normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş (kuadriseps tendonu ve patellar tendon, patella ve yerleşimi, femoral troklear oluk ve patellofemoral bağlar normal). Distal uyluk ve proksimal baldır kasları en belirgin gastrokinemyus kasının medyal ve  lateral başında olmak üzere atrofik.
